title: Reduction tower from an integral lattice is normalized
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient conventions of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]: $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell
e p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$, and $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n$ for $n\geq1$. Let $X_0$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme and $X=X_0	imes_{k_0}k$. On $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ use the completed coefficient sheaf $R_X=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}=\varprojlim_n(A_n)_X$ and its quotient projections of [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Let $K_{\mathcal O}\in D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$ be an integral object of [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], and suppose its derived reductions $K_n=K_{\mathcal O}\otimes^L_{R_X}(A_n)_X$ of [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction] lie in $D^b_{ctf}(X,A_n)$ for all $n$. Give these reductions the quotient-induced transitions of [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower], regarded as $t_{n+1,n}:K_{n+1}	o r_{n+1,n}K_n$ in $D(X,A_{n+1})$, where $r_{n+1,n}$ is restriction of scalars as in [def-trf-adic-system].

For every $n\geq j\geq1$, the map adjoint to the composite transition $t_{n,j}$ is the canonical derived associativity isomorphism
$$
u_{n,j}:K_n\otimes^L_{A_n}A_j\xrightarrow{\sim}K_{\mathcal O}\otimes^L_{R_X}(A_j)_X=K_j.$$
These are the actual adjoints of the quotient transitions, with $
u_{n,n}=1$ and $
u_{n,i}=
u_{j,i}\circ(
u_{n,j}\otimes^L_{A_j}A_i)$ under derived associativity for $n\geq j\geq i$. Thus the reduction tower with these transitions is a normalized $A_ ullet$-system in the sense of [def-trf-adic-system].
